title: 2027 schedule preview
description: Styled season and tour filters let you explore 2026 and provisional 2027 schedules, retaining Rolex, Major, Signature and Playoff colour highlights. Future-season data stays separate from current model inputs.

title: Simpler ROI navigation
description: Always-visible totals, a year selector and direct period/player/tournament views replace nested navigation while retaining existing figures and searchable, sortable tables.

title: Clearer site navigation
description: Separate Predictions, Performance and Betting menus, a direct Schedule link and clearer Explorer labels make pages easier to find.

title: Easier backtest exploration
description: Clearer summary cards and a searchable All/Included/Excluded event list make coverage easier to explore, with compact expandable player details and unchanged scoring.
